effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Appmon] trait and 1 card with the [Entertainment] or [Awakening (App Name)] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
link_effect_description_eng: [When Linking] Trash any 1 digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
